connections.title: Visitor geography database
connections.description: Downloads an offline database from DB-IP or MaxMind. Portaliq reads a visitor's country or region from it.
connections.disabledMessage: Geography is switched off. No database is fetched and no region is stored.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Not checked yet. Save the Visitor geography section, or run occ portaliq:traffic:geo-refresh.

connections.title: Login brokers
connections.description: DigiD, eHerkenning, eIDAS and OIDC brokers that residents and suppliers sign in through. Each portal organisation brings its own.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Not checked yet. The row reports after the next broker login. Each organisation keeps its broker settings in portaliq's app config.
